title: SmartNoise Synthesizers
summary: A package of differentially private tabular data synthesizers (MWEM, QUAIL, DP-CTGAN, PATE-CTGAN, PATE-GAN) from the SmartNoise/OpenDP project, this being a single-branch installable copy of smartnoise-sdk. It subclasses CTGAN's CTGANSynthesizer and DataTransformer from the standalone ctgan package to build DP-CTGAN and PATE-CTGAN, adding differential-privacy training on top of CTGAN's mode-specific normalization.
evidence: snsynth/pytorch/nn/dpctgan.py:12-111 imports CTGANSynthesizer/DataTransformer from ctgan and defines class DPCTGAN(CTGANSynthesizer)
needs: This is a mirrored branch of the third-party smartnoise-sdk project (not first-party SDV work); no individual authors named in README.
